title: lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig: SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS missing range allows zero
description:
LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS has no range constraint (line 246-252). A user can configure this to 0, which would cause division-by-zero in code calculating hop timing (e.g., superframe_index = time_ms / superframe_ms). Other time configs in this file have explicit ranges.

Fix suggestion: Add 'range 1 10000' or similar to prevent zero values. Example: range 10 60000 to match similar time configs in this file.
close_reason: Verified no-defect (stale bead): LICHEN_SYNC_HOP_SUPERFRAME_MS at lichen/subsys/lichen/link/Kconfig:254 has 'range 100 60000' (default 2000, depends on LICHEN_SYNC_HOP) — zero/unbounded config impossible. git log -S confirms both introduction commits (d0cae8b745, 27ece58f2f, 2026-08-26) added the symbol WITH the range; it never existed unbounded in committed history. Bead predates introduction. Single definition in tree (no duplicates); no .conf sets the symbol so default applies. Related C-side div-by-zero defenses remain tracked in open beads 90rz/y4rr. No files touched by this round → 3x codereview passes not applicable (nothing to review).
